findings.current: Apparently, he wanted to use his newly learned Wall Lizard Technique to climb straight up Mount Beimang.
findings.defect: This literalizes the Mount Beimang idiom and loses its function: Taekyung is saying Hyuk Mujin seems eager to get himself killed, setting up the next line’s punchline.
findings.rationale: Mount Beimang is associated with burial grounds here; the line jokes that Hyuk Mujin’s reckless plan is a direct route to death, not that he literally intends to climb that mountain.
findings.replacement: Apparently, he wanted to use his newly learned Wall Lizard Technique to climb all the way to Mount Beimang—straight into an early grave.

summary: Faithful overall, with one idiomatic death joke rendered too literally.
